# kilhog_network (Resource)

Manages a Kilhog network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kilhog_network" "production" {
  name        = "production"
  description = "Production network"

  tags = [
    {
      key   = "environment"
      value = "production"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique network name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Network description.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Key-value metadata tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Network UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag key.
- `value` (String) Tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kilhog_network.production "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
```
